newFamiliaMedSite.description:
(Project in progress) 

 Interface Design (UI/UX): 

Website implementation plan in Figma: Preparing the project timeline 

UI Prototypes (Draft): Developing preliminary designs for mobile (mobile-first approach) and desktop variants 

 

 Database Architecture & Data Modeling: 

Data model design (JPA Entities + DTOs + Mappers): Relational database design and automatic generation of table/relationship schemas using Spring Data JPA (Hibernate) 

 

 REST API Implementation & Business Logic: 

CRUD REST API Modules: Comprehensive API endpoint handling for the following modules: Specialization, Local, Office, Service, Price, Contacts, AboutUs, Feed 

Media / Images Module: REST API for file uploads with automatic image conversion to the optimized .webp format upon upload 

Time Validation (validFrom / validTo): Implementation of business logic verifying date ranges for services and prices, enabling hands-free scheduling of their availability and lifecycle well in advance 

Price Priority System: Introduction of a price prioritization mechanism allowing the definition of standard and promotional/periodic price lists (the application automatically selects the appropriate price within a given time window based on the assigned priority) 

 

 Security & Performance: 

SQL Query & Repository Optimization: Dedicated queries (e.g., using JOIN FETCH) in Spring Data JPA repositories to fetch relational data (services, galleries, locations) in a single SQL query, eliminating the N+1 queries performance issue 

Authentication & Authorization: Implementation of a security architecture based on JWT access tokens (Access Token + Refresh Token) for the admin panel 

Endpoint Protection: Restricting access to data-modifying endpoints (POST, PUT, DELETE) exclusively to authorized users with the administrator role 

Attack Protection (Rate Limiting): Integration of the Bucket4J library on public endpoints to limit the number of requests per second/minute 


 

 Unit tests for controllers, services, repositories, and configuration files 

 

 Error handling

muddyCodeWorkspace.description:
Working in an Nx monorepo within an extensive multi-application ERP system. The project involved the development and maintenance of multiple business modules as well as shared components and services.

Scope of work in business modules:

Sales Module:
Contractor directories, customer orders, price lists, and services.

PMS:
Technological and production logic, release versions, order register, calculations (features, feature relationships, valuation register), extensive dictionaries (tools, tool types, operations, workstations, work center rates, qualifications, modifiers).

Simulations:
Simulation versions and simulation register.

WMS:
Index groups.

LOGS:
System logs module (monitoring and presenting application logs).

MES:
Production control and monitoring system – handling production processes, recording employee work, monitoring production order execution, tracking material consumption, and real-time status tracking of production operations.

Services and System Architecture

QBE Service:
Building and handling Query By Example (QBE) queries.

Attachment Service:
Uploading and downloading attachments with transfer progress tracking (XMLHttpRequest with progress events), backend integration, and streaming downloads on the frontend.

User Settings – managing user settings stored in localStorage:
table and view configurations
language settings
access control

Authorization and Session Mechanisms
login and re-login mechanism (session recovery)
token expiration handling and request retries after token refresh
canceling pending requests upon user change
HTTP interceptors responsible for token and authorization handling
idle timeout mechanism based on user activity (mouse event tracking)

Application and Access Management

ActiveApp Service:
Controlling available applications and features per user (permissions system).

Components and UI Layer
Shared components:
loader
attachment component
error handling system based on a snackbar service
extension of the tree component (tree view, dynamic adding and removing of nodes, detail preview on hover, generation and presentation of process paths)
component development and support:
modal system
numeric keyboard component

Over more than 1.5 years on the project, I was responsible for developing the ERP system across the frontend layer, service architecture, and shared components. My work encompassed expanding existing modules, implementing new features, and stabilizing and scaling the system in an enterprise environment.

muddyCodeSite.description: The "Muddy Code" website was built using the Wix platform. It is a simple website featuring information about the company, offered services, and a contact section enabling direct communication with the client.

familiaMedSite.description: Project development and maintenance, SEO work (search engine optimization), analyzing and fixing existing bugs, and refactoring legacy system elements. Expanding the homepage and subpages (including Familiamed Clinique – eyelid surgery), as well as improving service performance and stability. Continuing and developing the project after previous teams, with a strong focus on improving code quality and user experience.

quickAtest.description: The "Quick Atest" single-page application was designed to streamline the process of creating and merging documents required for order fulfillment. It enables content filtering, generating data into an Excel file, and downloading selected documents as a single, merged PDF file.

muddyCode.description: Since January 2024, I have been growing as a Frontend Developer, responsible for building and maintaining web application interfaces. I focus on improving usability, performance, and visual consistency across products. As I gained experience, I transitioned to working on more complex system components and modules. I actively collaborate with backend and UX/UI teams, participating in designing and implementing new features.

montService.description: I was responsible for diagnostics, repair, and technical maintenance of equipment used in point-of-sale systems, such as cash registers and payment terminals. I performed installations, configurations, and troubleshooting of hardware and electronic faults. I ensured device reliability and rapid restoration of functionality, maintaining uninterrupted operations at retail points of sale.

aboutMePage.aboutMeDescription: I am a Frontend Developer with 3 years of experience in building modern and functional web applications. I combine programming skills with a keen eye for aesthetics and attention to detail, creating solutions that are not only efficient but also user-friendly. I quickly pick up new technologies and eagerly take on new challenges. Programming and computer science are my passion, which is why I continuously expand my skill set, also taking an interest in game development and emerging tech trends.
aboutMePage.freeTimeText: Outside of work, I actively practice sports, particularly boxing, which teaches me consistency, discipline, and perseverance in pursuing goals. I also enjoy reading good books, have a keen interest in history, and spend my free time playing video games.

sections.frontTxt: I focus on the Angular and TypeScript ecosystem, maintaining clean code architecture (Nx) and modern design (HTML5, CSS3, Bootstrap).
sections.backTxt: I design stable and secure APIs and business logic using Java and Spring Boot. For database management and object-relational mapping, I use JPA/Hibernate and relational databases (PostgreSQL / pgAdmin).
sections.testTxt: I ensure application quality and security using unit and e2e tests (Jest, Cypress), package management (npm), and modern authentication (Keycloak). For containerization and environment automation, I use Docker.
sections.graphicTxt: I use project management and issue-tracking tools (Jira) and design intuitive user interfaces and mockups (Figma).
sections.aiTxt: I leverage advanced language models (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini) directly in the browser to support daily coding, architecture design, code optimization, and solving complex technical problems.
